title: Addressing the Clinical / scientific SME
description: How to write for a reader acting as Clinical / scientific SME. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `clinical-sme` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Domain language, not implementation language
rules.description: Domain language, not implementation language. Say what the guidance CLAIMS before saying how it is encoded.

source.quote: Expert in the subject, not in the system. Judges whether the content is clinically right; is not interested in FHIR profiles or schema fields and should not have to be.
